inputs.label: alphafold3_input.py
inputs.note: This is the whole input: one amino-acid sequence, one SMILES string, one ion name. Everything else on this page is derived from it.

inputs.label: 721p-assembly1A_protein.a3m
inputs.note: First 400 of 15,953 aligned sequences. Searched from the query sequence, then reduced to the per-column profile the model consumes. Lowercase columns are insertions relative to the query.

inputs.label: 721p-assembly1.cif
inputs.note: Never given to the model. It supplies the sequence and the list of bound molecules, and its coordinates are the ground truth the prediction is compared against. Feeding it in would be answer-leakage.

inputs.label: predicted_structure.cif
inputs.note: Coordinates sampled by this repository's diffusion module, with per-atom pLDDT in the B-factor column. Weights are randomly initialised, so this is a real file in the right format holding a fold that never happened.

inputs.label: predicted_structure.pdb
inputs.note: Coordinates sampled by this repository's diffusion module, with per-atom pLDDT in the B-factor column. Weights are randomly initialised, so this is a real file in the right format holding a fold that never happened.

inputs.label: boltz_prediction.cif
inputs.note: Boltz-2 (MIT, open weights) on the same input — a genuinely folded structure, 0.75 A CA RMSD to the crystal.
